title: Electoral Roll Form 7 Deletion Filings in Key Constituencies
description: Investigative analysis of mass voter objection filings under Form 7 across specific urban and rural constituencies, tracking accepted vs rejected appeals and minority concentration correlation.
takeaways: Over 84,000 Form 7 deletion requests submitted across targeted districts.
91.4% of verified appeals revealed registered voters still resident at documented addresses.
Civil society oversight prevented unauthorized disenfranchisement in 72% of challenged cases.

Gaganyaan & Bharatiya Antariksha Station: Multi-phase orbital outpost deployment.

title: BRICS+ Expansion vs G7: Share of Global GDP (PPP) 2026
description: Following the historic induction of new member states, the expanded BRICS+ bloc now commands 37.8% of global GDP measured by Purchasing Power Parity (PPP), surpassing the G7's 29.4% share.
takeaways: BRICS+ accounts for 37.8% of global economic output (PPP).
G7 economic weight has declined from 44% (2000) to 29.4% in 2026.
Energy export consolidation: BRICS+ controls 43% of global crude production.

title: Global Maritime Chokepoints: Daily Oil Transit Volumes
description: Over 61% of total world maritime crude oil and petroleum transit passes through 5 vital waterways. Disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz or Bab el-Mandeb present instantaneous shocks to international energy pricing.
takeaways: Strait of Hormuz: 21.0 Million barrels/day (21% of petroleum consumption).
Strait of Malacca: 16.8 Million barrels/day connecting Asia to the Gulf.
Bab el-Mandeb & Suez: 7.2M and 6.6M barrels/day respectively.

title: Global Clean Energy Transition: Solar & Wind Additions (2020-2026)
description: Annual additions of solar photovoltaic and wind energy capacity have accelerated from 260 GW in 2020 to an unprecedented 585 GW in 2026, driven by plummeting module costs and national energy security mandates.
takeaways: 2026 Additions: 585 Gigawatts globally (82% of all new generation capacity).
Solar PV accounts for 74% of clean additions due to sub-$0.10/W module costs.
Asia leads global deployments with 62% of installations.

title: AI Chip Supply Chain: Advanced Node Foundry Distribution (<5nm)
description: The manufacturing of high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence accelerator chips remains heavily geographically concentrated, creating critical geopolitical dependencies across the Taiwan Strait.
takeaways: Taiwan (TSMC) fabricates 64% of all sub-5nm AI processors.
South Korea (Samsung) commands 18% of global advanced wafer production.
US domestic fabrication share is rising to 12% following CHIPS Act fabs coming online.
